_comment: Enriched seed list: property -> source -> backend -> extractor. Sources sharing scrape_source_id are fetched once per run (cached) and split per-property via 'params'.

acc_lightning.notes: GET https://www.americancampus.com/api/lightning/floorplans/{list_id}; default lease term; per-floorplan Attributes; Block splits by LocationFilter

ut_housing_nueces.notes: static Drupal rate tables; installment rates per apartment type

ut_housing_dobie.notes: static Drupal property-space articles; academic-year unit rates

appfolio_listings.notes: GET {portal}/listings; parse embedded googleMap markers; filter by street address

entrata_pp.notes: Entrata ProspectPortal white-label (Cloudflare-fronted, needs real browser). Layouts: .fp-card options table, .fp-data-wrapper rows, .fp-grid-item marketing grid, .floorplan-item list. params.extra_urls merges additional public bedroom pages in one session.

landmark.notes: Landmark Properties WP theme; .floorplan cards with total (--value) and Base Price (--base-rate)

rambler_lvbode.notes: LV Bode WP theme; .card.floorplan with data-* attrs + per-unit modal tables

sinclair_wp.notes: Custom WP; .element-item cards; room-type toggles (SMART Housing/Standard); .unit-status banner mixes promo+availability

repli360.notes: Repli360/RRAC widget rendered client-side; .rracFloorplan cards with data-* attrs; .call-for-pricing marks unpriced

sightmap.notes: Engrain SightMap public API (floor plans + available units with base price, total price incl. mandatory monthly expenses, specials). Site's own jd-fp cards hydrate too slowly to scrape; the SightMap feed is the same data source. Response is gzip.

yugo.notes: Yugo global site; article.product-tile with strikethrough discount pricing + urgency message

villas_wp.notes: WP theme; .floor-plan-card with title/beds/bath/size; price only shown for some plans

webflow_product7.notes: Webflow Relume product7 grid (24 Longview 2026 redesign); layout image + name + beds/baths/sqft; rent often unpublished

webflow_cms_floorplans.notes: Webflow CMS floor-plan cards. Sparq (collection-item-4): CSS-background image, rent usually Call for Pricing. GrandMarc (floorplan-collection-item): img.floorplan-image + published .price.bold; ignore hidden Call for Pricing and strikethrough .slashed.

rentcafe_ysi.notes: Yardi RENTCafe: window.ysi.floorplansList/unitsList embedded JSON; curl gets 403, needs real browser

knock_doorway.notes: Knock CRM doorway API: GET doorway-api.knockrentals.com/v1/property/{id}/units; layouts + available units w/ displayPrice

duda_appfolio_feed.notes: Duda site collection mirroring management co's AppFolio feed; filter by address

ut_offcampus_directory.notes: UT off-campus housing directory; unit JSON embedded in page. THIRD-PARTY directory, not property's own site

g5_sniff.notes: G5 Marketing Cloud GraphQL (inventory.g5marketingcloud.com); capture page's own XHR responses

realpage_sniff.notes: RealPage WS API (api.ws.realpage.com/v2) needs auth token; capture page's own XHR. Legacy .aspx shell, modern JSON underneath

jonah_chunk.notes: JonahSystems _fp-renderable chunk (session-bound); capture XHR, parse jd-fp-card-info blocks. No public pricing on Troubadour

spearhead_static.notes: Spearhead Properties WP single-property page; unit table w/ popovers, server-rendered

resolute_static.notes: Resolute Real Estate (broker) page; 'Unit X | n bed / n bath | sqft | $X/Month' Beaver Builder blocks

ninehundred_static.notes: 9HUNDRED WP page; plans listed w/ 'Call for Pricing' — structurally not_publicly_listed

sgs_static.notes: San Gabriel Square: per-plan Elementor sub-pages, beds/baths only, no pricing shown

mmc_ajax.notes: MMC/vNue WP theme (Villas on Nueces): fpRouter links enumerate plans; admin-ajax fragment per plan w/ Double/Single occupancy pricing

vsg_static.notes: Villas at San Gabriel: server-rendered bedroom-group tab panels (all plans in HTML). Cards: name, $, layout image, beds/baths/sqft

fp_units_modal_v2.notes: Craft/Servd floor-plan-units-modalv2: :units JSON embedded on the marketing floor-plans page. One advertised row per floorPlanId

gogetter_wc_floorplans.notes: Gogetter Network WooCommerce floorplan cards (Noble 2500). SiteGround-walled for curl; Playwright DOM. Prices often 'Contact us for rate'

vnue_grid_static.notes: vNue plan grid (Villas on 26th): names+details, rate slot usually holds availability text not price

rise_units.notes: Rise at West Campus: unit-detail modals w/ unit+plan+beds; site publishes NO prices (leasing flow only)

no_public_pricing.notes: explicit placeholder for sites with zero published pricing (Town Lake)

jonah_detail_json.notes: JonahSystems: static plan slugs on listing page; detail pages embed jd-fp-data-script-resource JSON (rent_min/max, term, availability_count). Supersedes jonah_chunk (browser) for these sites

realpage_cms_proxy.notes: RealPage CMS legacy .aspx sites: /CmsSiteManager/callback.aspx?act=Proxy/GetFloorPlans|GetUnits proxies WS API server-side, no auth

ut_rates_table.notes: generic UT Housing 'Type|Rate' tables; row_filter regex for shared pages (Gateway=GAT rows)

collegehouses_rates.notes: College Houses shared /rates/ page; per-house blocks w/ base rent + mandatory utilities/meals + Total Monthly cost. One fetch covers all co-ops

ballpark_static.notes: Ballpark elementor cards 'Name | N bed | N bath | sqft | Starting at $X'

westside_prose.notes: Westside pages: prose rent mentions + AppFolio vacancies; image-only prices flagged via params.image_price_note

uptown_realty.notes: Uptown Realty Austin custom WP; static <div class=ampti> Property/Unit Specifics cards (Bedroom/bath/Per month/Sq.Ft.). No floor-plan images exposed.
